data.one_liner: A flexible Flutter radar and spider chart widget with customizable colors and sizes.
data.what_it_does: It renders customizable radar and spider charts in Flutter. Users can display multiple radar tiles with configurable values, colors, strokes, and radii.
use_when: You need to display radar or spider charts in your Flutter application.
You want customizable colors, sizes, and borders for chart data tiles.
avoid_when: You require standard line, bar, or pie charts instead of radar charts.
You need highly advanced interactive data visualization tooltips or animations not provided by the package.
strengths: Flexible and customizable colors and sizes.
Supports multiple radar tiles on a single chart.
weaknesses: No explicit documentation for advanced features or complex gesture interactions.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: A widely used and actively maintained charting library in Flutter for standard chart types.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: A feature-rich commercial-grade charting library supporting many chart types including radar charts.

data.minimal_example:
RadarChart(
  length: 3,
  radius: 150,
  initialAngle: pi / 3,
  radars: [
    RadarTile(
      values: [0.4, 0.8, 0.65],
      borderColor: Colors.yellow,
      backgroundColor: Colors.yellow.withOpacity(0.4),
    ),
  ],
)
